study type: Cross-sectional comparative study and in vitro experiment
outcome: ULBP1 mRNA and protein expression levels in placenta
Uterine natural killer (uNK) cell biological functions (NKG2D expression, cytokine/chemokine production)
cohort: Placentas were collected from women with preeclampsia and normal pregnant women who underwent cesarean section.
finding: ULBP1 mRNA and protein levels were significantly upregulated in preeclamptic placentas, and ULBP1 inhibited HTR-8/SVneo cell invasion by modulating uNK cell functions, suggesting a role in preeclampsia pathophysiology.
cross-section timing: At the time of birth (placentas collected after cesarean section)
